_about: Survival: stranded by a crash, a wreck or a disaster, where the land, the weather and the group are the danger. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

disaster: a small plane down in the jungle canopy
a fishing boat sunk far from shore
a flash flood that took the bridge and the road
an earthquake that buried the town below
a bus off the road in a mountain pass
a trekking guide who never came back
a landslide that cut the valley off
a storm that wrecked the island resort
place: a limestone island in the Andaman Sea
teak forest in the hills along the Burmese border
a salt flat with no shade for days
a glacier valley above the tree line
a flooded river town in the monsoon
a mangrove coast at the turn of the tide
a frozen lake miles from any cabin
a canyon desert with one known spring
shortage: food that will keep for days
a lighter with any gas left
medicine for a wound turning bad
warm clothes for the cold nights
hours of daylight to travel by
hazard: a river too fast to ford safely
monsoon rain that does not stop
a cold that creeps in after dark
heat that drops people by the afternoon
a cliff path that crumbles underfoot
aftershocks that bring down what is still standing
a storm front rolling in from the sea
rift: someone is hiding food from the others
the leader's plan is getting people hurt
one of them wants to stay put and wait
an injured friend is slowing everyone down
two of them blame each other for the crash
a stranger who joined claims to know the way
the strongest wants a bigger share
someone has given up and stopped trying
way_out: a ranger station marked on an old map
a fishing village somewhere down the coast
a signal fire on the highest ridge
a raft built from the wreckage
a road beyond the pass, if it is open
a satellite phone with one bar of battery
a supply drop that may or may not come
the river, followed all the way down

1: the first night is colder than anyone planned
a small cut, a twisted ankle, a lost pack
2: the supplies will not last the week
the first plan fails and costs them
3: someone falls sick or badly hurt
the group splits over the way out
4: one last push for the way out
the land gives them one chance, and only one

cliches: a rescue helicopter arrives right on time
a fire from two sticks in a minute
the hoarder turns out to be a monster
a flare gun saves the day
